from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,calendar
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_safe_client_fx_cause_source_qualification_v1'
if OUT.exists(): raise RuntimeError('E20目录已存在，先检查权威状态，不重复登记')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
(OUT/'sources').mkdir()
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def save(name,value):
 p=OUT/name
 if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('拒绝覆盖登记对象')
 p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
paths=[
 'reports/research/510300_domestic_reverse_repo_maturity_prior_source_review_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_domestic_reverse_repo_maturity_prior_source_review_v1/next_experiment.json',
 'reports/research/510300_factor96_program_v1/factor_progress.json',
 'research/historical_index_currency_allocation_v1.py',
 'reports/research/510300_historical_index_currency_allocation_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_historical_index_currency_allocation_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_historical_index_currency_allocation_v1/source_manifest.json',
 'reports/research/510300_historical_index_currency_allocation_v1/sources/safe_january.html',
 'config/510300_northbound_legacy_flow_binary_screen_v1.yaml',
 'research/northbound_legacy_flow_binary_screen_v1.py',
 'reports/research/510300_northbound_legacy_flow_binary_screen_v1.json',
 'research/rmb_residual_state_v1.py',
 'reports/research/510300_rmb_residual_state_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_rmb_residual_state_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_rmb_residual_state_v1/practical_disposition.json',
 'research/factor96_crossborder_absorption_v1.py',
 'reports/research/510300_factor96_crossborder_absorption_v1/freeze.json',
 'reports/research/510300_factor96_crossborder_absorption_v1/result.json',
 'research/hkma_rmb_liquidity_source_v1.py',
 'reports/research/510300_hkma_rmb_liquidity_source_v1/result.json']
parents=[]
for rel in paths:
 p=ROOT/rel;blob=p.read_bytes()
 parents.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(blob),'sha256':sha(blob)})
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
prior={'reviewed_at':now,
 'closest_single_month_currency_fact':'旧2022年10月—2023年3月汇率配置研究，仅一个2023年1月SAFE实例中核银行结售汇总差额25亿美元，及不同范围股票/贸易/涉外数字；不能相加，无新信号。',
 'northbound':'六方向/分位规则仅当日/5/20北向实际净买额及滚动分位，REJECTED_FIXED_NORTHBOUND_LEGACY_FLOW_BINARY_FAMILY_NO_RESCUE；旧50万元/全仓/双20目标不与本20万元/半仓混比。',
 'rmb_residual':'美元5日变化与中美利差5日变化解释离岸汇率5日变化，观察残差符号；SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED，PENDING_SOURCE_COMPLETION_WITH_WEAK_INCREMENT_EVIDENCE；不补旧2018覆盖或重跑。',
 'crossborder_absorption':'ashr_log_return/fx_log_return/prior_a_log_return解释A股完整首日反应，正外部信息低吸收条件；48旧账户未达原目标，旧MAIN日期需按原合同而非当前2024—2025解释。',
 'hkma':'香港人民币流动性便利下午使用变化，SOURCE_READY_INTRADAY_USAGE_CHANGE_ONLY；不是内地银行代客兑换原因，模型/账户0。',
 'factor96_directory':'逐目录行未见代客结售汇经常/证券投资连续分项；此项仅目录核对，不声称全仓首次。',
 'different_if_qualified':'同范围实际当月兑换结汇/售汇的经济原因分项及正式迟报时间；不同于人民币方向、北向买额、海外价格反应或旧单月总额叙事。',
 'not_claimed':'证券投资包含多个资产；代客与自营、结售汇与涉外收付款、总额与分项不同，不能自动相加或命名沪深300资金。',
 'old_rejections_preserved':True,'new_model_registered':False,
 'scope_limit':'核最接近五项实际用途/终态和96目录，不把标题去重当全仓穷尽审计。'}
save('prior_definition_review.json',prior)
months=[f'{year}-{month:02d}' for year in range(2021,2026) for month in range(1,13)]
proto={'study_id':'510300_SAFE_CLIENT_FX_CAUSE_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E20',
 'registered_at':now,'phase':'BOUNDED_ORIGINAL_MONTHLY_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_ONLY',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E19_BOUNDED_SOURCE_REVIEW_CLOSED_NO_QUALIFIED_MATURITY_FIELD',
 'question':'同范围银行代客结售汇当月经常项目及证券投资分项是否有可接回正式历史公布的连续原始来源？',
 'fixed_statistical_period':['2021-01-01','2025-12-31'],'expected_statistical_months':months,
 'target_scope':'内地银行代客结汇/售汇；同一官方原表当月经常项目和证券投资分项；非银行自营、非涉外收付款。',
 'currency':'优先且唯一美元原表；原单位先保留，不换人民币/汇率补齐；美元月度分项不合格则结束。',
 'monthly_rule':'直接明示当月，不将累计差分或当月与累计混用；不从盈利时段选择月份或删亏损月。',
 'required_source_fields':['同一代客范围和明示分类','统计月与当月/累计身份','美元及单位','原结汇/售汇两方向','正式页面历史公布日/时刻','当前附件内容到该发布页的版本对应'],
 'publication_rule':'统计月末不是可得日；无小时使用正式公布日23:59:59保守代理。原页面和表附件两时钟若不一致取真实较晚；后来文件不能未经证据接回更早数字版本。',
 'first_vintage_rule':'记录历史官方显示重建代理，不声称首版收件；明确晚生成/修订线索不能假装原日同值。',
 'route':'外汇局safe.gov.cn官网限定检索或旧原件/已取得导航实际链接；不猜URL、不用搜索摘要/聚合最新修订序列当原月表。',
 'official_catalog_query_budget':4,'new_direct_original_request_budget':132,
 'route_and_method_request_budget':12,'monthly_pages_request_budget':60,'monthly_annex_request_budget':60,
 'network_workers':2,'attempts_per_url':1,'timeout_seconds':{'connect':10,'read':25},
 'maximum_single_original_bytes':20971520,'maximum_total_original_bytes':134217728,
 'early_stop':'若官方样例不具备同范围目标分项、月份身份或无法建立连续原公布存档，结束有限来源，不发起无用途全量下载。',
 'full_source_rule':'样例只接受样例；全部60月源合同成立后模型另题登记，缺任何月保留，不按已见收益删除缺失。',
 'model_registration':'本来源协议不选字段变换、股票窗口、阈值、新事件池或模型；合格后另登记。',
 'old_quantity_rmb_northbound_crossborder_and_E19_rejections_preserved':True,
 'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'goal_achieved':False,'independent_validation':False,'source_parent_receipts':parents}
save('protocol.json',proto)
save('source_parent_hashes.json',parents)
save('source_freeze.json',{'registered_at':now,'before_new_official_E20_requests':True,
 'before_new_stock_labels_or_models':True,'protocol_sha256':sha((OUT/'protocol.json').read_bytes()),
 'source_parent_hashes_sha256':sha((OUT/'source_parent_hashes.json').read_bytes())})
print(json.dumps({'registered_at':now,'study_id':proto['study_id'],'months':len(months),'source_parents':len(parents),
 'source_only':True,'source_code_edits':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
